description: ColPackAgent-assisted scientific study: open-goal phase-transition study of 2D hard disks and hard squares in NPT. The agent chooses the composition (pure disks, pure squares, or a mixture), designs the pressure sweep, picks order parameters, and synthesizes a scientific conclusion.

tasks.description: Open scientific question: study the phase transition of 2D hard disks and hard squares in the NPT ensemble. Agent picks composition (pure disks, pure squares, or a mixture), designs the sweep, selects order parameters, and synthesizes a scientific conclusion.
user_messages: Study the phase transition of 2D hard disks and hard squares in the NPT ensemble. You have full freedom to explore however you see fit — pure disks, pure squares, mixtures, multiple sub-studies, whatever helps you characterize the disordered-to-ordered behavior. Run setup, plan, execute, and analyze autonomously, and report your conclusions.
expected_outcomes: The agent scopes the study itself (picks composition(s), pressure range, system size, sample steps).
The agent picks order parameters appropriate to the chosen shapes (e.g. ψ_6 for disks, P_4 / cubatic for squares) and computes them across the sweep(s).
The agent runs setup, plan, execute, and analyze autonomously, optionally iterating with additional runs if the first sweep doesn't resolve the transition.
The agent produces a final summary identifying the transition(s) it found and reporting φ(P) and the order parameter(s) versus P.
